name: TE Connectivity
description: TE Connectivity designs and makes the connectors, sensors, relays, wire and cable, heat-shrink tubing and interconnects that carry power, data and signals inside cars, factories, aircraft, hospitals, data centres and the power grid. Three quarters of its Transportation segment is automotive (one car holds many TE parts, so revenue follows content per vehicle and vehicle production), while the Industrial segment, boosted by AI and cloud data-centre demand, grew 23.7 percent in fiscal 2025. Products are designed into customers' platforms and bought on long relationships; competitors range from large multinationals to thousands of local makers, with price pressure each year.

employees.note: About 93,000 people worldwide including 13,000 contract employees; about 55,000 in manufacturing; 34,000 Asia-Pacific, 34,000 EMEA, 25,000 Americas.

businessLines.name: Transportation Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells terminals, connector systems, sensors, relays and heat-shrink tubing designed into vehicle platforms; carmakers and tier-1 suppliers buy per vehicle built, so revenue = content per vehicle times production. Price erosion on annual contracts is a recurring headwind.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-09-26), sum of end-market sales

businessLines.name: Industrial Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells connectors, cables, relays, filters, energy-grid insulation and interventional medical components to data-centre and network builders, factory and appliance makers, aerospace and defense programmes, utilities and device makers: designed-in components bought repeatedly as customers build equipment.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-09-26), derived: total 17,262 minus Transportation 9,388

brands.name: Richards Manufacturing
brands.note: Acquired April 2025; contributed $179M of fiscal 2025 net sales, in Industrial Solutions.
